verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a payments and business-account product, so AI-generated insights from a user's financial data are a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack documents payments, cards, statements, webhooks and an llms.txt file, but nothing about in-product AI insights or suggestions. Statement exports and transaction APIs are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself, and the llms.txt file only makes the docs readable by AI tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
